title: Looking for a flatmate
instructions: Ben ev arkadaşı arıyor ve bir adayla konuşuyor. Kira, kurallar ve taşınma tarihine dikkat et.

script.speaker: a
script.text: So, this is the room. What do you think?

script.speaker: b
script.text: It's bigger than I expected. How much is the rent?

script.speaker: a
script.text: Three hundred and fifty a month, plus bills. Bills are about fifty pounds.

script.speaker: b
script.text: That's fine. Are there any rules?

script.speaker: a
script.text: Just two: no smoking, and please keep the kitchen clean.

script.speaker: a
script.text: When would you like to move in?

script.speaker: b
script.text: At the start of next month, if that's OK.

questions.prompt: What does Ana think about the room?
What is one of the rules?
When does Ana want to move in?
options: at the start of next month
questions.evidence: At the start of next month
